description: This PHP source file defines the UserAgentMiddleware class used for building and injecting user agent headers into AWS SDK HTTP requests. It manages various user agent components, including SDK version, environment, and metrics, and provides methods for middleware wrapping and request modification.

classes.name: UserAgentMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for constructing and injecting user agent headers into AWS SDK HTTP requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that returns an instance of UserAgentMiddleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with a handler and arguments.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to inject user agent headers into the request.

methods.name: requestWithUserAgentHeader
methods.description: Builds and injects the User-Agent header into the request.

methods.name: buildUserAgentValue
methods.description: Builds an array of user agent components based on configured functions.

methods.name: getUserAgentVersion
methods.description: Returns the user agent version string.

methods.name: getOsName
methods.description: Returns the OS name and version.

methods.name: appendEndpointMetric
methods.description: Appends endpoint override metric if applicable.

methods.description: Appends account ID mode metric based on args.

methods.description: Appends retry mode metric based on args.
